description:
Start a Word, Excel or PDF document built by Claude (POST /api/v1/documents). Paid by actual usage.

The balance is charged when the agent finishes each turn; a turn that ends with no result is refunded. With too
little money on the balance the answer is 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE and nothing is started.

This is a long task of several minutes: the answer comes at once with an id and status running. Do not wait
for it in this call; fetch the result with get_document until status is awaiting_input (a turn is done) or
failed. Needs format (docx = Word text document, xlsx = Excel workbook with real formulas, pdf = a finished PDF)
and brief (what the document is for, who reads it, the facts and data to use: the agent invents no data). tier
is fast by default (Claude Sonnet 5.5 with an Opus 5.5 advisor) or pro (Claude Opus 5.5 for the whole job, costs
more): use pro only when the user asks for the best quality or the chat model is Claude Opus. Optional title and
file_urls (up to 5 public HTTPS links to sources or samples: PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, MD, CSV, PNG, JPG, up to
25 MiB each and 45 MiB together; the server downloads them). A file the user gave you instead of a link is
uploaded first with upload_media (a document up to 10 MiB here), and the url it returns goes into file_urls. Run
estimate_document first when the user asks the price. Reuse idempotency_key on a retry after a timeout so that
one document is not started twice. Tell the user the document takes a few minutes.
name: create_document
